before: **v1.17.0 is a source-only release candidate, not a published image.** Do not switch a running installation to `v1.17.0` until a signed-off release and native image preflight are complete. Unlike v1.16.2, v1.17.0 contains a PostgreSQL migration for reversible album links. Before upgrading, stop application writes, back up the entire persistent `/data` volume, verify a restore to an independent test instance, and keep the existing `/music` mount unchanged. If rolling back across the migration, restore the pre-upgrade `/data` backup; changing the image tag alone does not downgrade the database.
after: **v1.17.1 is an unpublished source candidate, not a published image.** The currently published stable image is v1.17.0. v1.17.1 adds no new PostgreSQL migration or audio re-enrichment, but the stable v1.17.0 release already contains a database migration for reversible album links. Before upgrading, stop application writes, back up the entire persistent `/data` volume, verify an independent restore and keep `/music` mounted exactly as before. Never point an older image at a migrated database; restore the matching pre-upgrade `/data` backup when rolling back across a migration.
